known_limitations: Collector cleanliness checks cover local Boolean, port and file-context configuration but do not prove absence of custom policy modules.
Effective permissive-domain facts are collector-reported inline extraction, not independently server-verified from retained policy bytes.
Catalog families are bounded reference facts, not a complete SELinux policy representation or proof of administrator intent.
Loaded-policy SHA is exact observed identity, not a universally reproducible distribution build identifier.
